d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is trying to project restraint on Red Sea access while drawing a hard line against Eritrea in his address to parliament. Dismissing talk that Ethiopia will wage an invasion over the Red Sea, Abiy insisted Addis Ababa seeks a maritime outlet through dialogue and shared development—yet warned that "destruction" will fall upon Eritrea if Asmara continues acting as a supply line or arming forces hostile to Ethiopia. Recalling the arc from the 2018 peace deal and northern conflict solidarity to post-Pretoria friction…
